Resolves #21629

Related: #21346 · #21140 · #21613

Adds `examples/board/cardDesigns`, a 32-article editorial calendar across five workflow stages (`Idea`, `Draft`, `Edit`, `Scheduled`, and `Published`) backed by `Neo.data.Store` (`ArticleStore`) and `Neo.data.Model` (`ArticleModel`). A custom-styled segmented pill control (`Compact`, `Standard`, `Detailed`, using `Neo.button.Base` `pressed`) updates `board.cardItems` in place across all five built-in `Neo.board.CardItems` renderers (`title`, `text`, `tags`, `progress`, `avatars`) without reloading or resetting column `scrollTop`, while articles intentionally missing `tags`, `percentDone`, `editor`, or `author` omit empty item nodes cleanly without gaps or `"undefined"`.

**Catalog record for #21613:**
- `id`: `'board-card-designs'`
- `name`: `'Card designs'`
- `feature`: `'The same articles as compact, standard and detailed cards, built from five card items'`
- `lookFor`: `'Switch between the three designs: the cards re-draw in place and keep their columns.'`
- `cover`: The Detailed design (`carddesigns-1440x900-detailed-dark.jpg`).

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline + guards ran`

Evidence: L3 (Playwright E2E `CardDesigns.spec.mjs` in `e2e-engine` CI + headless Chromium `1440 × 900` & `390 × 844` dark/light renders across all three card designs and two swapped-order cold-look evaluations) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-6). Residual: none for #21629; batch catalog publication lives in #21613.

## Deltas from ticket

- Derived `people` as `[author, editor].filter(Boolean)` (`depends: ['author', 'editor']`) on `ArticleModel` because `Neo.board.CardItems.avatars` preserves `null` elements inside raw array fields (`asList([author, null])` would render an empty `''` avatar span); filtering on the model field ensures missing editors or unstaffed pitches omit absent circles cleanly.
- Seeded 32 articles with a realistic 14-pitch `Idea` column funnel (`14 + 5 + 5 + 4 + 4`) so `Idea` retains positive scroll overflow even in `Compact` mode rather than triggering native browser `scrollTop → 0` clamping when card heights shrink.

Frame critique: Whole-surface verdict is `BETTER` vs `board/basic` on both desktop (`1440 × 900`: `9.0 / 10` & `9.0 / 10` vs `7.5 / 10` & `7.0 / 10`) and mobile (`390 × 844`: `8.5 / 10` & `8.5 / 10` vs `7.0 / 10` & `6.5 / 10`). Self-inspection and two swapped-order cold reads surfaced five actionable visual nits, all resolved in the shipped frames: (1) deepened the five desk accent colors (`#f59e0b` for `Tech`, `#10b981` `Climate`, `#0ea5e9` `Cities`, `#6366f1` `Science`, `#ec4899` `Culture`) so light-mode `Tech` progress bars and stripes hold strong contrast against white cards; (2) tightened the sub-toolbar readout (`Detailed · 5 card items: title · standfirst · tags · progress · avatars`) and enabled mobile wrapping so `390 × 844` renders cleanly on one line with zero right-edge clipping or orphan words; (3) laid out the mobile `Compact | Standard | Detailed` segmented control on a symmetrical 3-column grid (`grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))`) and hid unused `.neo-button-glyph` nodes; (4) replaced `2 a.m.` with `02:00` on `art-2` to avoid a quadruple-dot `a.m....` clamp boundary; and (5) reworded `art-17` (`Cartographers who hand-draw shaded relief...`) to avoid participial-apostrophe ambiguity. Retained intentional engine/layout trade-offs: overflowing columns clip naturally at the `.neo-board-column-body` scroll viewport and horizontal mobile scroll peeks ~58px of `Draft` at the right edge (standard `Neo.board.Container` mobile rhythm), `-webkit-line-clamp: 2` truncates long headlines at CSS glyph boundaries, `Compact` accurately reflects the 14-pitch vs 4–5-stage editorial funnel (`Draft`–`Published` sit comfortably above the fold), avatars share a calm theme-token circle fill (`--editorial-avatar-bg`) while desk stripes carry category color, and `⋯` / `<` icons stay owned by `Neo.board.Card` and `Neo.board.Column`.
